newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: ABN AMRO mulls opening Cambodia branch.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO mulls opening Cambodia branch.

text.p: Leading Dutch bank ABN AMRO is considering opening a branch in Cambodia and has sent representatives for talks with the Cambodian central bank, a National Bank of Cambodia (NBC) official said on Tuesday.
"ABN AMRO has come to consult with us three times already," the central bank official told Reuters. "We would welcome such a big bank coming here."
The official said the central bank had not yet received a formal application from the Dutch bank.
There are currently a total of 28 commercial banks operating in Phnom Penh, most of them foreign-owned.
